<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, peaks between ~110‑160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. Excluding the carbonyl signal at 166.40 ppm and the aliphatic signal at 52.24 ppm, there are 16 distinct peaks in the aromatic region, indicating 16 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
